name: BriefRooms governed multi-instrument weekly paper exposure

strategy_tournament.rule: Select the highest-utility directional candidate using only earlier closed paper legs. The selected candidate is a proposal, not a forced trade: the NO_TRADE admission gate may abstain. Counterfactual observations of all candidates may reduce exploration uncertainty, but only realized selected-strategy legs drive the legacy global performance adjustment.

champion_challenger.rule: Research ranks every candidate, but only execution-authorized Champion-pool methods may open a paper position. A Challenger remains shadow/counterfactual until an explicit governed promotion. Opposing execution candidates inside the utility margin resolve to NO_TRADE, never by method name.

contextual_learning.rule: Learn separately for each instrument, strategy and matching market context. At every closed paper leg evaluate every candidate that was present at entry on the same entry-to-exit path. Do not change contextual utility until at least six earlier observations exist in the exact context. Apply Bayesian-style shrinkage and cap the contextual adjustment at +/-2 conviction points. Counterfactual samples reduce exploration uncertainty but never masquerade as realized selected-strategy PnL. Open frozen positions are never rewritten by learning.

eurusd_ma_structure.rule: Use W1 MA support/resistance as the primary structure signal, D1 price-vs-all-MAs as confirmation and H1 price-vs-all-MAs only as timing. H4 and M1 never veto a trade. The MA layer is a bounded context adjustment and never a standalone trade trigger.

macro_context.interpretation: Falling oil and falling US10Y support EUR/USD; rising oil and rising US10Y support the dollar. Inputs are normalized, capped and never used as standalone trade triggers.
macro_context.rule: The open position is not rewritten retroactively. Macro context enters new decisions and the governed 23:00 daily review.

no_trade.fallback_direction_rule: A default tie direction may rank a directional candidate, but it never overrides the NO_TRADE admission gate.
no_trade.rule: NO_TRADE is a first-class active state. A directional candidate is opened only when the admission thresholds are met; otherwise WES may keep monitoring for a later qualified trigger.

trade_status_contract.planned: frozen directional forecast only; no execution claim and no entry price required
trade_status_contract.pending: qualified immutable execution decision exists; waiting for the first eligible bar
trade_status_contract.open: entry executed; positive entry_price and entry timestamp required
trade_status_contract.no_trade: admission abstained; no entry is expected
trade_status_contract.expired_no_entry: authorized/pending execution expired without a valid fill; no entry or P/L may be fabricated
trade_status_contract.closed: executed position settled; entry and exit facts required

execution_integrity.rule: A directional forecast is not an executed position. Entry is required only after execution is claimed; every executed entry timestamp must be on or after the immutable decision timestamp.

risk_execution.btc_primary_source: Coinbase Exchange BTC-USD 5m candles plus live ticker
risk_execution.btc_fallback_source: Yahoo Finance BTC-USD 5m bars only when Coinbase evidence is unavailable

directional_admission.rule: Every new entry requires WES directional admission for the exact execution-authorized method and direction. Admission authorizes a thesis, not a market-price fill. WES 1.2 must additionally freeze an Entry Price Plan before execution. If Daily and Weekly are both valid, aligned and opposite to the proposed trade, admission is blocked.

entry_price_engine.fill_rule: BUY LIMIT fills only when a post-decision 5m bar Low touches the frozen target; SELL LIMIT fills only when High touches the frozen target. Fill price is the frozen target, never the later market quote.
entry_price_engine.rule: Direction and price are separate decisions. WES may authorize LONG/SHORT while execution remains WAIT. A deterministic pullback target is frozen from the decision-time reference price, ATR14, EMA20 distance, 5-day momentum, 55-day range position and post-stop reversal state. No first-bar market entry is permitted.
